{{samename|Warrior from [[Pokémon Conquest]]|Saizō}} ''For other characters named Saizō in Japanese, see [[Saizō (disambiguation)]].'' {{CharInfobox| color={{rock color}} | corecolor={{rock color light}} | bordercolor={{poison color dark}} | name=Saizo | jname=サイゾ| tmname=Saizo| slogan=no | image=Saizo unmasked.png | size=250px | caption=Saizo in {{aniseries|XY}} | gender=Male | hometown=[[Ninja Village]] | region=[[Kalos]] | trainer=yes | trainerclass={{pkmn|Trainer}} | game=no | leader=no | team=no | brain=no | anime=yes | epnum=XY052 | epname=A Stealthy Challenge! | enva=[[Vic Mignogna]] | java=Kōsuke Toriumi | }} '''Saizo''' (Japanese: '''サイゾー''' ''Saizō'') is a recurring character who first appeared in ''[[XY052|A Stealthy Challenge!]]''. He hails from [[Ninja Village]]. ==History== [[File:Saizo.png|thumb|left|250px|Saizo wearing a {{p|Shiftry}} mask]] Prior to the events of ''[[XY052|A Stealthy Challenge!]]'', Saizo gave [[Sanpei]] a mission to deliver a secret scroll to a mansion by sunset. As Sanpei went on his way, however, Saizo appeared in his way in a {{p|Shiftry}} mask, along with his {{p|Barbaracle}}, claiming to be battling him for possession of the scroll. Although [[Sanpei's Greninja]] put up a fight, Barbaracle poisoned it with a {{m|Poison Jab}}, while the two eventually ended up falling into the river, eventually being found by {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}. Saizo later appeared to battle Sanpei again, but this time Sanpei was assisted by Ash. Knowing he and Ash wouldn't be able to defeat Saizo, Sanpei used his ninja techniques to escape. Saizo, still disguised, ambushed Sanpei again, this time inside a cave where he managed to kidnap {{ashfr}} to stop them from intervening in Sanpei's trial. However things did not go according to plan, with Ash managing to stay by Sanpei's side and {{TRT}} interrupting the next confrontation. However, Saizo quickly fought Team Rocket off, then continued the battle. While Barbaracle managed to temporarily gain the advantage against {{AP|Froakie}} and Greninja, Froakie eventually evolved into a {{p|Frogadier}} and defeated Barbaracle. From there, Saizo then left. While invisible to Sanpei and Ash, he said that Sanpei may head to the mansion, and there he will learn the secrets about his companions. As the two reached the mansion, Saizo appeared yet again, and unmasked himself, much to the surprise of Sanpei. He revealed that the scroll was in fact empty, and that the mission was designed to test what Sanpei had learned in his journey. Saizo commended Sanpei's efforts, namely his resourcefulness and bond with Greninja, and awarded him a pass on the mission. He was seen in a flashback in ''[[XY099|The Legend of the Ninja Hero!]]''. Saizo reappeared in person in ''[[XY100|A Festival of Decisions!]]'', returning to save [[Ninja Village]] from the vengeful [[Kagetomo]] and the Ninja Corps. He managed to weaken [[Heidayu]]'s {{p|Bisharp}} with a powerful {{m|Razor Shell}} attack from his Barbaracle, aiding Ash and Sanpei. He later alerted Ippei and the others that Kagetomo was behind the attack, and directed everyone's attention to nearby [[Otori Mountain]] where chief {{kal|Hanzo}} had been taken. Saizo later joined the counter-offensive against Kagetomo. He helped [[Shinobu]], {{an|Clemont}} and {{an|Serena}} defeat the Ninja Corps in a battle. He also witnessed the battle between Ippei and Kagetomo, in which the former emerged triumphant. Afterwards, Saizo attended the village festival to watch Ippei announced as the new chief of Ninja Village. ==Character== Saizo is incredibly skilled in the ninja arts and is also an instructor, having helped train [[Sanpei]] in ''[[XY052|A Stealthy Challenge!]]''. He and his partner {{p|Barbaracle}} are agile and swift in their approach, often utilizing unconventional strategies for a perfect defence in battle. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|1|java|scope=section}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Saizo |pkmn=Barbaracle |type1=Rock |type2=Water |img=Saizo Barbaracle.png |epnum=XY052 |epname=A Stealthy Challenge! |vaen=Billy Bob Thompson |desc={{p|Barbaracle}} is Saizo's only known Pokémon. Just prior to ''[[XY052|A Stealthy Challenge!]]'', Barbaracle fought against [[Sanpei]] and his {{p|Greninja}}, poisoning it and leaving both injured. It later battled Ash's Pikachu and Froakie, but their attacks didn't do anything to it. It later followed {{ash}} and {{ashfr}} who went with Sanpei to reach his goal and fought against [[Ash's Pikachu]], [[Ash's Froakie]] and Sanpei's Greninja, blinding Pikachu and Greninja with {{m|Mud-Slap}} and crashing Froakie into a rock, but Froakie evolved into {{AP|Frogadier}}, who used its new {{m|Aerial Ace}} attack to defeat Barbaracle. Barbaracle appeared in a flashback during ''[[XY099|The Legend of the Ninja Hero!]]'' and reappeared alongside its trainer in [[XY100|the next episode]], saving Pikachu, Frogadier, and Greninja from [[Heidayu]]'s {{p|Bisharp}} and defeating it. It was shown in a flashback in ''[[XY139|Facing the Needs of the Many!]]''. Barbaracle's known moves are {{m|Razor Shell}}, {{m|Poison Jab}}, and {{m|Mud-Slap}}.}} ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{rock color}}|bordercolor={{water color light}} |ja=鳥海浩輔 ''Kōsuke Toriumi'' |en=[[Vic Mignogna]] |fi=Antti Lang |fr_eu=Marc Weiss |he=גדי לוי ''Gadi Levy'' |pl=Przemysław Wyszyński |pt_br=Sílvio Giraldi ([[XY052]]) |es_eu=Juan Antonio Soler }}
